implementation_contract.input: Java int[]; null returns false; non-null elements are non-negative and total sum <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
implementation_contract.partition: every input position belongs to exactly one of two groups; either group may be empty
implementation_contract.result: boolean indicating whether the two group sums can be equal
implementation_contract.primary_implementation: one-dimensional 0/1 subset-sum dynamic programming targeting total/2
implementation_contract.oracle: exhaustive subset enumeration on bounded random inputs

checks: empty input and single zero under the explicit empty-group candidate contract
negative input rejection under the explicit non-negative candidate contract
5000 deterministic random non-negative arrays checked against exhaustive subset enumeration
input equality checked before and after every non-null evaluation to detect mutation
